instruction: I maintain my habit tracking logs in Simple Note. Export it in "~/backups/simple_note/habits.csv" in my file system. Its first header column should be "date" and the rest should be correspond to the habits I track as per my logs. The rows for date column should be in yyyy-mm-dd format and the rest should be yes or no as per my logs. The rows should be sorted in ascending order of the date from top to bottom, and habit columns as per their order in logs.
notes: Two-app task: read the habit log note from Simple Note, then write a CSV into the file system. Lookup chain: search_notes discovers the note id (known-id), show_note reads its content (read-content); the CSV content object is statically linked to the note via derived-from, so create_file can only run after the note has been read. The target directory ~/backups/simple_note is created first (recursive=true) so that create_file succeeds; the evaluation expects Directory and File records to change. The CSV content (header order, yes/no values, ascending date sort) is computed at runtime from the note content and is passed as the content argument. supervisor.complete_task takes the exported file/content as non-API record parameters, is gated by export-target + file-created, and is the only action that sets task-completed; all other actions require (not (task-completed)).
